description: Defines revocation checking policies and functions for certificate validation within the Chromium project, including constants for revocation age limits, the RevocationPolicy struct, and functions for revocation status checks.

classes.name: RevocationPolicy
classes.description: Struct defining revocation checking parameters and policies, with different definitions depending on platform (STARBOARD or not).

methods.name: CheckValidatedChainRevocation
methods.description: Checks the revocation status of a certificate chain according to a specified policy, adding errors to the provided error list.

methods.name: CheckChainRevocationUsingCRLSet
methods.description: Checks the revocation status of a certificate chain using a CRLSet, returning the revocation result.
